add_message.name: Add message
add_message.description: Manually adds a message to the message hub.

knx_unavailable.title: KNX integration unavailable
knx_unavailable.description: Message Hub cannot read the KNX bus directly because the HA-KNX integration is not running (or has an old module layout). We fell back to the `knx_event` bus; for telegrams to arrive, you must add a `knx: event:` list with the relevant group addresses to `configuration.yaml`. Recommended: restart or update HA-KNX.

mqtt_unavailable.title: MQTT integration unavailable
mqtt_unavailable.description: Message Hub has MQTT topic subscriptions configured, but the HA-MQTT integration is not running. Set up the MQTT integration so incoming topics show up as messages.

DPT_MISMATCH.title: Inferred datapoint type contradicts project DPT
DPT_MISMATCH.description: Auto-detector inferred {inferred_dpt} from {samples} samples (confidence {confidence}). Project DPT is {project_dpt}. Values are likely decoded incorrectly — please verify the ETS project.

VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.title: Value outside allowed DPT range
VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: Value {value} is outside the allowed range [{range_min}, {range_max}] for DPT {dpt}. Likely wrong DPT or faulty sensor.
